program.name: Calm Bell 35
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: One kettlebell, slowly: bell core, slow supersets, then yin.
program.about: Slow kettlebell strength in about half an hour. Each day opens with a kettlebell core circuit, pass-arounds, pull-throughs and arm bars, then slow supersets with the bell, then long yin holds. Two days change the lifts and the yin. Level II slows every rep down and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Bell core, slow bell supersets & yin A / B, 35 minutes
